scope: Observed local Windows formats only; no runtime MCP or four-client E2E claim

sources.user_assistant: record.type user/assistant; message.content string or typed blocks
limitations: Only observed typed blocks are characterized
Unknown content blocks require a partial diagnostic

sources.tools: custom_tool_call.call_id -> custom_tool_call_output.call_id; output may be a list
limitations: event_msg item IDs do not always equal response_item IDs
Use response_item as the canonical stream, never concatenate both streams
Older function_call variants not characterized by the latest-three sample
reasoning, world_state and developer/system instructions excluded

sources.identity: trajectory_meta.cascade_id / source artifact ID; steps.idx; transcript.step_index
sources.user_assistant: step_type 14/15; step_format=0 wrapper fields 19/20; user_response(2)/query(1); modified_response(8)/response(1)
sources.tools: planner tool_calls(7).id(1) -> steps.metadata.tool_call(4).id(1); run_command type21 wrapper28; other tool types use transcript with truncation flags
limitations: transcript alone is truncated and lacks reliable project identity
Only observed protobuf field mappings and format=0 characterized
items/scopes/media and all generic tool payloads are not fully decoded
Empty planner text with tool_calls is legitimate
No immutable access to an active WAL database

sources.timestamp: bubble.createdAt or verified timingInfo; composerHeaders timestamps are session timestamps only
sources.user_assistant: cursorDiskKV composerData:<id>.conversation or fullConversationHeadersOnly -> bubbleId:<composerId>:<bubbleId>; type1 human/type2 AI
sources.tools: bubble.toolFormerData.{toolCallId,name,rawArgs,params,result,status}; preserve native encoding and missing-field diagnostics
limitations: Missing workspace association must not be guessed from attached file paths
Null values are tombstones, not empty successful messages
Many bubbles have no event timestamp
Cloud history and official Markdown export not validated
